about: Who uses this site and what each of them can do, one BPMN diagram per kind of person. tools/flows.mjs lays each flow out and writes flows/<id>.bpmn; /admin/flows draws them. A step's type is start, end, timer, user, manual, service, task, gateway or parallel. A ref is a path in this repository, then optionally a space and what in it — the validator fails on a path that does not exist. A step's `when` is the signals that mean somebody took it — page:<id> a page opened, view:<id> what that page counts as a view, or the name of a press as assets/track.js reports it, with @<page> where the name means something else elsewhere — and is what /admin/flows counts the step by; a gateway never has one, and a signal names one step per flow. `handover` marks a step that begins on somebody else's device, which no one browser walks into. An edge is [from, to] or [from, to, label]. See 'Who uses the site, drawn' in README.md.

flows.name: A visitor, signed out
flows.who: Anybody who opens the map without an account. Nearly everything works for them: the map, the chat, saving, reading lists and profiles, feedback. What they meet a sign-in for is a discount code and keeping somebody else's list.

nodes.name: Reads Discover, on a phone
nodes.note: A plain arrival on a phone opens on a page in front of the map: the map as one card, then new lists, the most opened places, a Play card offering one list to go round, popular lists and what is new on the map. Open map, a place on a shelf, the Places pill or an answer from the find bar leaves it for the map, and Back returns to it. A link about something — a place, a list, a chip — skips it, and so does a desktop.

nodes.name: Browses the map, the chips and the search
nodes.note: A chip that would leave nothing on screen pulls the map back instead. Surprise me picks from what the chips allow. A search of five letters or more can be looked up on Google Maps as well: what Google finds goes on the map as results, and is kept for the next search. The locate button draws the dot the list measures from, and takes a typed place when the device will not say.

nodes.name: Finds anywhere in Tallinn
nodes.note: On the map first, then Google's 1,112 venues.

nodes.name: Opens a place
nodes.note: A pin, a row in the column, a result of the search, or a deep link /?spot=<id>.

nodes.name: Adds Google's block and the save counts
Goes, walks, rides or drives to, or shares the place
nodes.note: Share sheet on a phone, else the clipboard. The link is /?spot=<id>&from=share, the tag taken off the address again as it opens.

nodes.name: Answers with one to three places
nodes.note: Workers AI on the free daily allowance, shared by preview and production. No account needed.

nodes.name: The answer's pins on the map
Presses the bookmark on a place
Files the save under this device
nodes.note: The owner is the device's random id. 403 challenge when Turnstile fails, 429 capped past five saves from one fingerprint.

nodes.name: Takes the account offer?
nodes.note: Offered once a visit, and not again for 14 days after a no.

nodes.name: Watches a story, reads the blog, plays the radio
nodes.note: The blog, like every page, opens in a frame over the map; the radio plays on underneath.

nodes.name: Opens a list, a profile or /lists
nodes.note: From the map, in a frame over it — the map and its radio stay. A shared link loads the page whole.

nodes.name: Answers public lists only
nodes.note: A private list is its owner's alone; anybody else gets a 404.

nodes.name: Posts feedback or hearts a post
nodes.note: Anonymous by default, filed under the device. Signing in on the same form puts a name on it.

nodes.name: Stores it, capped per hour
ref: functions/api/feedback.js POST say, heart, unheart, remove

nodes.name: Presses Sign in to use it on a discount
nodes.note: The offer is drawn for everybody; the code takes an account.

nodes.name: Signs up or signs in
nodes.note: A username of 3 to 24 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, in any alphabet, and a password — or Google, which makes the account at once under a drawn name like kringel-4821, changed later on the account page. Inside Instagram, Facebook or TikTok, Google is offered from the phone's own browser instead. No email. The iPhone app offers the same two and Apple, which makes its account the way Google does.

nodes.name: Opens a session, claims this device's saves
nodes.note: Then back to the page that asked, over the map. From Save on a list, that list is kept on arrival.

flows.name: A member, signed in
flows.who: Somebody with an account: a username and a password or Google. Everything a visitor can do, plus saves that follow them, lists of their own, keeping other people's lists, walking a list and checking in at its places, discount codes, a page under their name, posts on the blog, and flashcards (drawn on its own). A save, a keep and a discount happen where they are; everything else starts on the account page.

nodes.name: Opens their account page
nodes.note: Their saves, their lists and the ones they kept, and the doors to everything else a member can do.

nodes.name: Files the save under the account
Creates it
nodes.note: Up to 24 lists, 429 too-many past that.

nodes.name: Adds places, notes, what to order
nodes.note: Up to 50 places. A place the picker does not have is looked up on Google Maps, and one Google does not have either is typed in and found by address.

nodes.name: Stores each edit
ref: functions/api/lists.js POST add, drop, order, say, mustOrder, edit, place, delete

nodes.name: Adds it to Lists you saved
nodes.note: 400 own on your own list, cap of 200.

nodes.name: Walks a list
nodes.note: Any list they can read, on foot, by bike or both: starts a walk, checks in at each place with the phone's location, in any order and over as many days as it takes, can have the places left put in the shortest order from where they are standing, and may leave a comment where they checked in and one on the whole of it at the end. The board under the places opens: pressing anybody's time there shows how that person walked it, place by place in the order they really checked them, with the real gap between each pair.

nodes.name: Checks the nearest place within 75 m, keeps the place and the time
nodes.note: The location a check sends is compared and not kept.
ref: functions/api/walk.js POST start, mode, check, note, order, again

nodes.name: Admits the account, draws the hour's rate
Shows the code (see the discount diagram)
Edits the page under their name
nodes.note: A line about themselves, three handles, the languages they speak, a page of links with their public lists among it in the order they drag them — the line and the links in as many of the site's languages as they write them in.

nodes.name: Stores the page
ref: functions/api/account.js POST display, about, lines, links, speaks, rows

nodes.name: Writes a post for the blog
nodes.note: Headings, bold, links, lists, quotes, places from the map and public lists a reader swipes through, ten at the most, in as many of the site's languages as they write it in. A draft until they publish it; 20,000 characters, 10 new a day, 200 in all.

nodes.name: Stores it, a draft or published
Reads who opened it, their lists and their posts
Counts views of their own page, lists and posts
Changes it, signs other devices out on a new password
Deletes their account
nodes.note: Asks for the password, or the username on an account made through Google. No undo.

nodes.name: Deletes the account and everything filed under it, keeps the numbers

flows.name: A discount, at the table
flows.who: The one journey that crosses people: a guest with an account shows a code that changes every hour, and a waiter checks it with an ordinary camera and no account. The counter's page is the fallback when the camera will not scan.

nodes.name: Sees an offer on a place
nodes.note: On a place of the map, or on the card of a Google place the deal is filed under.

nodes.name: Signs in from the sheet, lands back on the pass
Admits the account, draws the hour's rate
nodes.note: 401 sign-in without a session, 503 with no database or salt. The rate is the same for the whole hour and nothing is stored.

nodes.name: Draws the QR, the code and a live countdown
nodes.note: code = HMAC(the deal's key, place:hour[:rate]), five characters. The countdown is what tells a live pass from a screenshot.

nodes.name: Points the phone's camera at the QR
Checks the hour and the code
nodes.note: Accepts the hour before and after. Everything is checked on the waiter's phone; no request is made.

nodes.name: Compares with this hour's code
nodes.note: The owner sends staff.html?r=<id> once and the restaurant bookmarks it.

flows.name: Flashcards, a learner
flows.who: Somebody learning Estonian on flashcard.tallinntastebuds.ee. Signed out, the first time, they are put in front of the first card and get five words; coming back, they are welcomed back to where they left off with the days they have practised in a row. An account remembers every answer, spaces the next time, and lets them write decks of their own.

nodes.name: Opens flashcards
nodes.note: From More on the map's rail, in a frame over the map, with the map's radio still playing; on the subdomain, whole.

nodes.name: Answers the shelf and the words, in one request
Opens a deck, a lesson, a song or a conversation
nodes.note: A stranger's front door opens on the first card of Hello and goodbye; anybody coming back is put back where they left off. Deeper stages open as the count of known words grows. A case lesson's Got it goes straight on into the deck that follows it. A song is listened to, and every word in it pressed for what it means. A conversation is read sentence by sentence, each sentence heard by pressing its speaker and every word in it pressed for what it means. A lesson's every sentence and every form in its tables is heard by pressing it.

nodes.name: Finds their level: twenty-five questions
nodes.note: Pick the meaning, fill the gap, write it. Ends at a stage, which opens it and every stage under it whatever the count of words; signed out the answers wait in the tab for an account.

nodes.name: Turns a card: got it, or not
nodes.note: Undo one answer, a hint once a card, hear it spoken.

nodes.name: Five words, then the sign-in card
nodes.note: The answers are kept in the tab and sent once they sign in. The step keeps the id it had when it was one word, so its counts stay one line.

nodes.name: Remembers it and spaces the next time
nodes.note: Boxes of 1, 3, 7, 14, 35 and 77 days; a miss goes back to the start. And the day, for the days in a row the front door counts.

nodes.name: Writes a deck of their own
nodes.note: Members only. 20 decks, 200 cards each.

nodes.name: Stores the deck and its cards
ref: functions/api/flashcard.js POST deck, card, editcard, uncard, drop

nodes.name: Says a card is wrong
nodes.note: No account needed.

flows.name: Chess, against the house
flows.who: Everybody on /chess: anybody, signed in or not, plays the city's game against the house; a member also queues to play the house one on one or challenges another member; the house is the owner's account, playing every game from the same page with a different face.

nodes.name: Opens /chess
nodes.note: By its address, or by holding Surprise me on the map for five seconds: nothing on the site links to it. One page for everybody, in three faces.

nodes.name: Answers the whole page in one request
nodes.note: The boards with their moves, and the legal ones for whoever may move now; the line, the duels, the notes and the asks. Asked again every twenty seconds while the page is on screen.

nodes.name: Plays a move
nodes.note: Everybody's, while it is Everybody's turn: anybody, a visitor filed under the device. Or a game of their own, the house's in either. A tap on a piece, then where it goes.

nodes.name: Takes it back, within ten seconds
nodes.note: Only in the tab that moved, and never a move that ended the game.

nodes.name: Checks it against the rules and files it
nodes.note: The move names the ply it answers, so somebody else's first is a 409 and the board redraws. The rules are held to published counts in CI.

nodes.name: Gives the game up, offers a draw, or agrees
nodes.note: Behind a confirm. One person resigns or offers alone; Everybody needs two names, a visitor counting. A player declines an offer; the city plays on instead.

nodes.name: Counts the names on the ask
nodes.note: Worked out from the rows and the moves on every read. An ask short of its names lapses two moves on.

nodes.name: Records the result
nodes.note: Mate, stalemate, repetition, fifty moves, too little left, a resignation or a draw agreed. A public game given up or drawn starts the next one by itself.

nodes.name: Every open page redraws on its next ask
Leaves a note for whoever moves next
nodes.note: Under the public game while it is on. A member chooses whether their name goes on it; the author may delete it.

nodes.name: Files the note, five an hour from one network
Joins the waiting list
nodes.note: Signed out, the card says sign in on the map. One place an account, left any time before the game starts.

nodes.name: Puts them in line
nodes.note: The queue is the private games not started yet, oldest first, and everybody sees the names.

nodes.name: Waits for the house
nodes.note: The page says the game has started on its next ask, and nothing else does: the site has no address for anybody.

nodes.name: Challenges another member
nodes.note: Found by the start of a username, or in the waiting list. Whoever challenges plays white; five going at most.

nodes.name: Accepts, or declines
nodes.note: The other member, on their own page's next ask. A challenge nobody answers lapses in seven days.

nodes.name: A game of their own, on the same board
Claims a duel the other has left for seven days
Starts a game with the first in line
nodes.note: One private game at a time. The member opens as white.

nodes.name: Starts the next public game
nodes.note: After a mate or a stalemate; a game given up or drawn by agreement starts the next one by itself. The colours swap.

nodes.name: Ends a game a member has left for seven days
Over, and it counts for nobody
Off the page, still counted against its author

flows.name: The owner
flows.who: The person whose site this is, and any account ADMINS names. /admin.html, signed in as one of them, posts stories and discounts straight to the live branch and puts a place on a branch of its own that lands by itself when every check passes; /admin/stats, /admin/visitors, /admin/found, /admin/flows and /admin/google answer only a signed-in account named in ADMINS. Nothing under /admin/ is counted, so this diagram carries no numbers.

nodes.name: Opens /admin.html
nodes.note: Linked from nowhere, noindex, served no-store.

nodes.name: Signed in on the site as an admin?
nodes.note: An account ADMINS names, with its password or Google. That is the whole door; the site holds the GitHub token.

nodes.name: Signs in
nodes.note: The map's own sheet, and back to /admin.html.

nodes.name: Posts a story
nodes.note: The photo or video is squeezed on the device first.

nodes.name: Commits it to the live branch
Its from comes round
nodes.note: Up for 36 hours; an hourly job files it away after.

nodes.name: Finds it in Google's directory, writes their take
nodes.note: Name, address, pin, phone and website come from Google; types, price, a line and photos are the owner's.

nodes.name: One commit on admin/add-<id> or admin/edit-<id>
Rebuilt and checked; lands on the live branch if green
nodes.note: A red check puts nothing live and keeps the branch.

nodes.name: Commits deals.json to the live branch
Sends the restaurant its staff link, once
Reads the stats, the visitors, how they found the site, the diagrams and their numbers, Google's directory and budget
Answers the owner only
nodes.note: Anybody else gets a 404 for the pages and a 403 for the data.
